newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani party names Sharif for prime minister.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani party names Sharif for prime minister.

text.p: The Pakistan Muslim League (PML), which won general elections on February 3, on Friday named its leader Nawaz Sharif as prime minister, the state television said.
A meeting of the parliamentary group of the PML and its allies unanimously elected Sharif as their parliamentary leader. He will be formally elected prime minister on Monday.
The PML and its allies won more than a two-thirds majority in the 217-seat National Assembly (lower house) and Sharif is certain to be elected prime minister for the second time.
He will replace ousted prime minister Benazir Bhutto, whose three-year government was sacked by President Farooq Leghari on November 5 on disputed charges of corruption and misrule.

Bhutto has accused Leghari and a caretaker government installed after her sacking of rigging the February 3 elections, but has said her party will not launch protests in the interest of the country"s stability. The government denies the rigging charge.
